items.title: DOH to distribute free condoms on World AIDS Day
items.description: In line with the observance of World AIDS Day next month, the Department of Health will distribute condoms free of charge to the public through its regional offices, HIV treatment hubs, and local government units.

items.title: Philippines, Japan envoys sign notes for emergency loan
items.description: The Philippines and Japan signed and exchanged notes for an “Emergency Support Loan” of up to 70 billion yen for “Enhancing Economic Resilience and Poverty Alleviation,” the Japanese embassy announced yesterday.

items.title: Lawyers question ICC limits on victim participation
items.description: The legal representatives of victims in the crimes against humanity case against former president Rodrigo Duterte have opposed the possibility of further limits to victim participation in the ongoing proceedings at the International Criminal Court.

items.title: Oral arguments on BSKE postponement urged anew
items.description: Election lawyer Romulo Macalintal has again asked the Supreme Court to hear oral arguments on his pending motion for partial reconsideration challenging the constitutionality of the law postponing the November 2026 barangay and Sangguniang Kabataan elections.

items.title: VP’s ex-staff never held captive – lawyer

items.title: US eyes $2 billion financing for Philippines defense, West Philippine Sea deterrence
items.description: The United States yesterday announced multibillion-dollar deals with the Philippines, including Foreign Military Financing loan package of more than $2 billion and direct financing of $400 million, aimed at expanding its longtime treaty ally’s operational reach and deterrence capabilities in the South China Sea.
